\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\addtocounter{table}{-1}
\renewcommand{\theHtable}{\arabic{table}.3}
\caption{The calibrated family (continued). Constrained-reference comparisons. The reference is the estimated feasible envelope of the near-optimal constrained-POMDP reference of Section~\ref{sec:cpomdp}, the largest reward attainable by mixing its sampled points subject to expected usage at most $B$, flat at the largest sampled reward where $B$ exceeds the largest sampled usage. That reference was evaluated on the canonical seeds with once-per-seed seeding. Same-stream reference is the same envelope with every sampled reference policy re-evaluated on the held-out seeds under the family's per-episode seeding, and paired gap is the mixture's reward minus that envelope, per seed, with its seed-level SE. Reference support and mixture weights are fitted on those same held-out seed means and held fixed for the SE. The nominal pointwise plug-in intervals discussed in the text omit uncertainty from that fit and cap feasibility, and make no multiplicity adjustment. Target reference is the best mixture of sampled reference policies, including subsidized ones with negative usage penalties, whose held-out usage equals $B$, and target gap is the paired held-out gap against it (\texttt{results\_budget\_frontier\_target\_reference.csv}).}
